s.note: the busy holy city of Jedha
s.how: Brush 4 flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill until blistered at the edges. Cut into wedges and serve with a tub of hummus, pickled turnips and kalamata olives in little bowls.

s.note: the palm-lined beaches of Scarif in the final battle
s.how: Toss 600g peeled green prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, a chopped chilli and the juice of a lime and marinate 20 minutes. Thread onto skewers and grill until pink and charred. Dice a mango with coriander and lime for salsa.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, thyme and 375ml stout and simmer covered for 3 hours until tender. Ladle over 1kg potatoes mashed with 60g butter. Rain on the windows optional.

w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate, whisk in 2 yolks, then fold in 2 whites whipped with 40g sugar and 150ml whipped cream. Set in 4 round moulds overnight. Turn out and glaze with 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream and a little cocoa. Press a dent in each.

d.note: Chirrut and Baze, the guardians of Jedha
d.how: Steep 4 tsp green tea with a sliced knob of ginger in 1L water at about 80C for 3 minutes. Strain and stir in 2 tbsp honey. Serve hot in small cups, or chill and pour over ice. I am one with the Force.
